sections.heading: C - New York Driver Manual Chapter Thirteen: ADAS
sections.markdown:
## C - New York Driver Manual Chapter Thirteen: ADAS

FACT_ID: sec13-F01 | anchor: A01
Newer-vehicle assistance features save lives and curb injuries when properly used by sensing and watching conditions, spotting present and coming dangers, and helping dodge crashes through alerts like sound or vibration or through seized braking or steering. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=78]

FACT_ID: sec13-F02 | anchor: A01
The roster spans blind-spot warning, back-up cameras, forward-collision warning, automatic emergency braking, lane-keeping assistance, and active parking assist among others. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=78]

FACT_ID: sec13-F03 | anchor: A01
Road tests forbid parking assist and cruise control, since features assist rather than drive, leaving drivers engaged and focused with head checks mirrors and cameras while owning safe operation and never leaning on gadgets alone. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=78]

FACT_ID: sec13-F04 | anchor: A01
Equipped driving demands constant focus, owner-manual fluency, limit literacy, and weather-hill-curve skepticism since rain snow ice fog grades and bends can defeat features. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=78]

FACT_ID: sec13-F05 | anchor: A01
Sensors stay clean and whole, software stays current per maker guidance where applicable, and proper use promises fewer crashes injuries and deaths. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=78]

FACT_ID: sec13-F06 | anchor: A02
Testing permits back-up warning, blind-spot monitoring and warning, and rear sideview plus surround-view cameras. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=79]

FACT_ID: sec13-F07 | anchor: A02
Testing further permits curve-speed warning, bicycle pedestrian and obstacle detection, forward-collision warning, high-speed alert, and lane-departure warning. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=79]

FACT_ID: sec13-F08 | anchor: A02
Parking sensors and rear cross-traffic alerts complete ten permitted warning systems. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=79]

FACT_ID: sec13-F09 | anchor: A02
Testing permits automatic emergency braking and brake assist, automatic reverse braking, lane-keeping assist, and left-turn crash avoidance. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=79]

FACT_ID: sec13-F10 | anchor: A02
Testing bans adaptive cruise control and automatic parallel parking, the lone prohibitions. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=79]

FACT_ID: sec13-F11 | anchor: A02
Examiners judge unassisted safe operation and reliance-free driving with final scoring authority. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ny-d:new-york-state-department-of-motor-vehic:handbook#pdf_page=79]
